The '''Bnar system''' was a part of the [[Braxant sector/Legends|Braxant sector]], located in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained the astronomical object [[Bnar VII]].<ref name="AIR" />

The career of the [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] [[Tir'uh]], which by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] spanned [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]], saw her operate within an area of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] spanning from Bnar VII,<ref name="AIR" /> in the northern section of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]],<ref name="TEA" /> to [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]],<ref name="AIR" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the galaxy's eastern portion. Between [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the Bnar [[Star system/Legends|system]] was situated in the borders of the [[Pentastar Alignment]], and it fell within the territory controlled by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] between [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]] and [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bnar system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-3.<ref name="TEA" />
